s.note: Smoked trout whipped with cream cheese, lemon, dill and horseradish, spread thick on rye crackers with pickled red onion on top.
s.how: Flake 250g hot-smoked trout, removing any skin and bones. Blitz half with 200g cream cheese, the juice of half a lemon, 2 tsp horseradish and pepper, then fold in the rest of the trout with chopped dill so it stays chunky. Slice half a red onion thin and soak in 3 tbsp white wine vinegar with a pinch of sugar for 20 minutes. Spread thick on rye crackers and top with the pickled onion.

s.note: Roast pumpkin soup with onion, garlic and stock, blitzed silky and finished with cream, poured from a thermos into mugs with toasted pepitas.
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 1kg diced pumpkin with oil and salt and roast 30 minutes until caramelised. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in butter for 5 minutes, add the pumpkin and 750ml chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes. Blitz until smooth and stir in 100ml cream. Toast 40g pepitas in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Pour the soup into a warmed thermos and scatter pepitas on each mug.

m.n: Gabe's ranger hut rump steak with foil-baked potatoes
m.how: Wrap 4 potatoes with a knob of butter each in foil and bake in the coals for 45 minutes. Rub 4 rump steaks with salt, pepper and chopped rosemary. Grill over hot coals for 4 minutes a side and rest on a board.

w.note: Thin pastry rolled around apples, raisins, cinnamon and buttery breadcrumbs, baked at 190C until golden, icing sugar and cream.
w.how: Toss 4 sliced green apples with 60g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 50g raisins and 40g breadcrumbs fried in 20g butter. Layer 8 sheets filo, brushing each with 60g melted butter, pile the apple along one edge and roll up. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, dust with icing sugar and serve with 200ml cream.

d.note: Dark rum stirred into hot water with spiced butter and brown sugar, for the grown-ups.
d.how: Beat 80g soft butter with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg and cloves. Put a heaped tablespoon in each of 4 mugs with 45ml dark rum and top with 150ml boiling water. Stir until melted.
